parameters: If a player teleports somewhere Briney isn't, Briney's position needs to be updated to prevent softlocks
\bMy POKéMON and I, we've been riding\na hot winning streak.
\bSo I decided to make my Battle Tent\ndebut in this town.
\w[signskin]Battle Tent Verdanturf Site\n“Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”
\bDid you see the cave next to the\nPOKéMON Mart?
\bThere's a guy in there who's trying to\nbust up boulders so he can bust out\nthrough to the other side.
\bIt'd be great if we could go through…\nIt'll make it easy to visit Rustboro.
\bThat cave next to the POKéMON Mart\nis now a tunnel to the other side.
\bIt's great--it's easy to go shop for\nnew Devon products in Rustboro now.
\bThe way the winds blow, volcanic ash\nis never blown in this direction.
\bThe air is clean and delicious here.\nLiving here should do wonders for even\nfrail and sickly people.
\w[signskin]“The Windswept Highlands With the\nSweet Fragrance of Grass.”
\rHe says this tunnel is full of\ntimid POKéMON.
\rThey get all scared of loud noise and\nmake a big uproar.
\rSo they had to stop the big tunnel\nproject.
\rBut there's one man. He's trying to dig\nthe tunnel by himself!
\rThere was a man who dug a tunnel for\na lady he loved.
\rI don't really get it, but hey!
